sector_model: industrial technology (data center power and cooling equipment): EV/adjusted operating profit, P/E, FCF yield, organic growth, backlog and orders, acquisition effects, leverage; cyclical AI capex exposure
thesis: Vertiv Holdings (NYSE: VRT) sells power, thermal and services equipment to data centers. Q3 2026 10-Q read (financial statements and notes; MD&A section not retrieved) and the 2026-10-28 release read. Net sales Q3 4,312.8M versus 2,675.8M (+61%; release says 55% organic, about 6% acquisitions), 9M 10,236.6M versus 7,349.9M (+39%). 9M GAAP operating profit 2,061.8M (20.1% margin versus 17.0%), 9M net income 1,652.4M, diluted EPS 4.21 versus 2.27. Release: organic orders more than doubled, Q3 adjusted operating margin 25.2%, adjusted free cash flow 652.2M (9M 2,230.3M; my GAAP OCF minus capex for 9M is 2,235.6M, matching). FY2026 guidance raised: net sales 14,450-14,850M, organic growth 37-39%, adjusted operating profit 3,475-3,555M, adjusted EPS 7.10-7.20, adjusted FCF 2,600-2,800M. Balance sheet 2026-09-30: cash 3,512.9M, total debt 2,928.5M (March 2026 2.1B senior notes repaid the term loan; 2.5B undrawn revolver, 4.0x net leverage covenant), total liabilities 12,672.5M, equity 5,502.0M. Subsequent event: UIG acquisition closed 2026-10-26 for 1.45B cash plus up to 1.15B contingent, which turns about 0.78B net cash into roughly 0.67B net debt pro forma (my arithmetic, ignores leases). At the 2026-11-10 close of 194.22 and 385.06M Class A shares (cover, 2026-10-26) market cap is about 74.8B: about 27x guided adjusted EPS midpoint 7.15, about 21.5x EV to guided adjusted operating profit midpoint (3,515M), and guided adjusted FCF yield about 3.6%. 9M GAAP EPS annualized (rough) gives about 34x. The market is paying for a doubling of orders to persist; the stock moved +14% after the print.
counterthesis: Everything rests on AI data center capex continuing: customer concentration, order lumpiness and the delivered backlog were not read (MD&A and backlog figures unread; release gives no backlog). Q4 guide implies sales of 4,313-4,513M, flat to +5% sequentially after +61% year on year, so the growth rate must decay from here. Acquisitions (PurgeRite 1.14B, UIG 1.45B plus up to 1.15B earn-out) add integration and goodwill risk and consume the cash pile. Adjusted EPS and adjusted operating profit exclude items I have not reconciled; GAAP-to-adjusted gap, SBC and tax rate unread. At about 27x adjusted earnings and 3.6% FCF yield a capex pause by a few hyperscalers would compress both multiple and earnings. Share price moved from 176.73 to 207 in a week, so the entry is volatile. Mega cap AI exposure also overlaps with broad index funds.
invalidation: Organic orders growth falling below revenue growth (book-to-bill under 1), backlog decline, hyperscaler capex cuts, adjusted operating margin below 22%, goodwill impairment on PurgeRite or UIG, or net leverage above about 2x after the earn-out.
